title: Monkey
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M70 68 Q88 66 86 48 Q84 36 74 40' fill='none' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#A0622F'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='11' ry='11' fill='#E8B47A'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='64' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 30 64)'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='64' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 70 64)'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='83' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='83' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='9' fill='#A0622F'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='5' fill='#E8B47A'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='9' fill='#A0622F'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='5' fill='#E8B47A'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#A0622F'/>
    <!-- face patch -->
    <path d='M50 22 Q68 22 68 40 Q68 56 50 58 Q32 56 32 40 Q32 22 50 22 Z' fill='#E8B47A'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3B2412'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3B2412'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#6E4520'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M44 50 Q50 55 56 50' fill='none' stroke='#6E4520' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
